title: A part-sales-only user adding a customer from a part sale sees the reps
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose role has "Part Sales — Create & Edit" but not "Customers — Create & Edit" or "Work Orders — Create & Edit", at {Location-A}.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Part Sales Only with the custom role ZZAUTOTEST SSR Part Sales Only; {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Staff member {Staff-member-D} is active at {Location-A} with the "Sales Representative" switch off.
    For example: {Staff-member-D} is ZZAUTOTEST Dan Noswitch.
  • Starting screen: the Part Sales page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Start a New Part Sale and choose to add a new customer from it.
  2. Click the Sales Representative field in the New Customer window.
  3. Read the options in the dropdown from top to bottom.
  4. Pick {Sales-rep-A}, fill in the required details and save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the New Customer window opens with a Sales Representative field.
  • Step 2: the dropdown opens and lists the sales representatives; it is not empty and shows no access-denied message.
  • Step 3: "Unassigned" is first, then every active sales representative sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z (including {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}); {Staff-member-D} is not listed; there is no search box.
  • Step 4: the customer is created with {Sales-rep-A} as its sales representative.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R3: “Its dropdown starts with "Unassigned", followed by every staff member whose Sales Representative switch is on and whose account is active, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z, as on the work order (S1-R8). Every one of them is listed, however many there are. It has no search box (S1-R12). The same list shows when the New Customer window is opened from a part sale by a user who can create part sales but not customers.”
  • Story 4 prerequisites: “User has 'Customers — Create & Edit' enabled, or 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' when the New Customer window is opened from the work order window, as today, or 'Part Sales — Create & Edit' when it is opened from a part sale.”
  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (19 Oct 2026), read 20 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 16: “16. (a) Show and list the sales representatives, as when opened from a work order.”
